question_en: Among DOW, IFF, STLD and SHW, which had the largest shareholders' equity at the end of 2021, and how do the four rank?
question_vi: Trong số DOW, IFF, STLD và SHW, công ty nào có vốn chủ sở hữu lớn nhất vào cuối năm 2021, và thứ hạng của cả bốn ra sao?

question_en: Seagate's revenue dropped in its fiscal third quarter this year compared with the same quarter last year, right?
question_vi: Doanh thu của Seagate giảm trong quý 3 năm tài chính năm nay so với cùng quý năm ngoái, đúng không?
reference_answer: No, Seagate's revenue did not fall; it rose 44.1%, from $2,160 million in the third quarter ended March 28, 2025 to $3,112 million in the third quarter ended April 3, 2026 (fiscal 2026).

question_en: ABBV's dividends paid went down in fiscal 2022 versus fiscal 2021, didn't they?

reference_answer: No, AbbVie's dividends paid did not fall; they rose 8.4%, from $9,261 million in fiscal 2021 to $10,043 million in fiscal 2022.

question_en: What was STLD's compound annual growth rate in equity-based pay expense from fiscal 2021 to fiscal 2025?
question_vi: Tốc độ tăng trưởng kép hàng năm của chi phí thù lao bằng cổ phiếu của STLD từ năm tài chính 2021 đến năm tài chính 2025 là bao nhiêu?
reference_answer: The compound annual growth rate was -4.5% (a decline), as the expense fell from $80.2 million in fiscal 2021 to $66.8 million in fiscal 2025.
evidence_quotes: Compensation expense for these stock-based employee compensation plans was $80.2 million, $50.7 million, and $43.3 million for the years ended December 31, 2021, 2020, and 2019, respectively.
Compensation expense for these stock-based employee compensation plans was $66.8 million, $65.6 million, and $60.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

question_en: Of Dollar General, Altria, McCormick and Coca-Cola, who spent the most on buying back its own stock in fiscal 2022, and how do the four stack up?
question_vi: Trong số Dollar General, Altria, McCormick và Coca-Cola, công ty nào chi nhiều nhất để mua lại cổ phiếu của chính mình trong năm tài chính 2022, và bốn công ty xếp hạng ra sao?
reference_answer: Dollar General was highest with $2,748,014 thousand of common stock repurchases in fiscal 2022, followed by Altria at $1,825 million, Coca-Cola at $1,418 million and McCormick at $38.8 million.
